upcoming.title: Jarlath Regan - "Gas Man"
upcoming.body:
A BRAND NEW Standup Show From “Yer Man” Off Instagram. 

Ireland’s favourite comedian/Mammy translator, Jarlath Regan returns to the stage with a brand new show for 2026. The world knows and loves him for his hilarious daily clips, now it’s time for you to see this Gas Man in person. Jarlath Regan’s brand new 2026 standup comedy show is packed to the gills with his unique brand of spot on observational standup material and ridiculous stories. “Prepare to cry with laughter” (The Post)Following millions of views and a sell out world tour, Jarlath is making good on his promise to bring his audience a brand spanking new show every single year. Now is your opportunity to grab a ticket.

We are all going to need a laugh in 2026 and Jarlath is here to deliver it. In this world of unending negativity, bleakness and cynicism there’s never been a better time to come and escape from it all for a night of quality laughs courtesy of “the jewel in Ireland’s comedy crown” (The Examiner).

Jarlath first burst into the public consciousness in 2023 when his Instagram and TikTok videos took the world by storm. Patrick Kielty dubbed him “A comedy master at work”. The Irish Times refers to him as a “comedy genius”. Audiences can’t get enough. Jarlath’s last tour was a sell out across America including 5 nights at the legendary Gramercy Theatre off Broadway. In 2025 the Kildare man travelled globe and won the hearts of audiences across Canada, Australia, the U.K. and Ireland. His January residency at Dublin’s 3Olympia has now become a fixture in the comedy calendar.

Last year he promised us a brand new show for 2026. Even his wife struggled to believe he could do it but somehow he has. Gas Man features 90 minutes of jokes and stories never before seen on stage or screen. If you like your comedy smart, sharp, warm and searingly funny, then this is the show for you.

“I forgot what it felt like to cry in public, through laughter” - The Irish Post.

“Universally enjoyable – 90 minutes of jaw-achingly funny anecdotes which spanned every topic imaginable.” - The Post

“A subtle yet sublime helping of observational wit” The Herald ★★★★★

“Downright hilarious…comedy genius” The Irish Times ★★★★★

“Had the audience shaking so violently with laughter they probably could have charged their phones” Edinburgh Festivals Magazine

“Regan is an expert storyteller and this is a beautifully constructed show that I could have happily listened to for twice its length.” ★★★★ The Arts Desk

upcoming.title: Flora Luna - Album Release w/ KC is Lazy
upcoming.body:
Buy TICKETS

Doors - 7:00pm
Show - 8:00pm

All Ages, Presented by the West End Cultural Centre

$25-$30

All tickets subject to service fees

Lush alternative pop in French and English. For fans of Feist, Klô Pelgag, Norah Jones
Singer-songwriter folk - For fans of Julie Doiron, Ruth Wainwright, Madeleine Roger

Flora Luna, alias Geneviève Freynet, est une artiste primée de Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada qui propose une pop alternative luxuriante en français et en anglais. Lauréate du prix Réseau des grands espaces/Les oreilles en pointes (France) et nommée aux Prix Trille Or en 2025, elle trace sa voie sur la scène franco-canadienne. Comparée à Salomé Leclerc, Klô Pelgag et Feist, Flora Luna séduit par sa voix expressive, sa sensibilité à fleur de peau et ses ambiances cinématographiques, entre tempête intérieure et clarté lumineuse.

_____________________

Flora Luna, also known as Geneviève Freynet, is an award-winning artist from Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada who offers lush alternative pop in both French and English. Winner of the Réseau des grands espaces/Les oreilles en pointes (France) award, and a 2025 Trille Or nominee, she is making her mark on the Franco-Canadian music scene. Compared to Salomé Leclerc, Feist and Klô Pelgag, Flora Luna captivates audiences with her expressive voice, raw emotional sensitivity, and cinematic soundscapes - balancing inner storms with radiant clarity.

_____________________

KC is Lazy German-born now based in Canada, Singer-Songwriter KC Is Lazy matured through the DIY folk scene in Berlin, and rapidly became an Americana touring staple through Germany, EU and UK.

Rolling Stone Magazine described her music as: "A far cry from boring Folklore."

After a move to London, UK and a decade later to Winnipeg, Canada she writes, produces and records her body of work that is rooted in folk tradition yet leads into unique perspectives.

KC Is Lazy presents herself in her own, eerie, plaintive and rootsy style by drawing from a well of personal history and culture, playing a variety of instruments on her recordings and invites the listener to explore the landscapes of her tunes alongside her.

The melodies she plays teem with ideas and perfectly accompany her unique voice and vocal arrangements which she captures in her live setup accompanied by some of Winnipeg, Canada's finest musicians.

upcoming.title: Holy Void + Par Àsito w/ Strawberry Punch
upcoming.body:
Buy TICKETS

Doors - 7:00pm
Show - 8:00pm

All Ages, Presented by the West End Cultural Centre

$30-$35

All tickets subject to service fees

Psychedelic/Garage Rock, 90s grunge does 60s girl group pop. For fans of DIIV, Thee Oh Sees, King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, Black Angels, Brian Jonestown Massacre, SLIFT, The Breeders, Heavenly

Winnipeg’s psychedelic pentad Holy Void pushes the boundaries of contemporary psychedelia by charting sonic dimensions with a fervor that captures the depth and complexity of the human psyche. Their innovative use of classical instrumentation and fearless experimentation, Holy Void elevates psychedelic rock, creating music that is as heavy as it is haunting.

Space Psych and Interdimensional Frequencies — Tour 2026 Par Ásito is a lost signal in space-time, an echo of 70s science fiction resonating between the ether and distortion. Their sound evokes the twisted biopunk visions of Stuart Gordon’s films, fused with the cyberpunk futures of William Gibson’s books. Amid analog synths, ethereal guitars, and hypnotic rhythms, they build sonic landscapes worthy of a forgotten film. It’s a collision of frequencies, extraterrestrial echoes, and distortions of alternate realities.

Strawberry Punch is an all-femme queer band from Winnipeg, MB. Featuring four multi-talented women rotating instruments throughout a show to create a seamless blend of sweet indie twee pop and moody riot grrrl garage punk-rock sounds. The band gains a wide range of influence from 60’s girl group pop and 90’s indie rock. The combination is fun, raw, and incredibly catchy with memorable hooks, shimmering guitars, and the sweetest 4 part harmonies. Strawberry Punch released their debut album on May 1, 2026.
